WITH detail_complete_times AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_detail_complete
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.session,
    d.first_detail_complete,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT COUNT(*) 
      FROM activity_log al2 
      WHERE al2.session = d.session 
        AND al2.stamp < d.first_detail_complete 
        AND al2.search_type <> ''
    ), 0) as pre_event_count
  FROM detail_complete_times d
),
first_detail_event AS (
  SELECT 
    al.session,
    al.path,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.session ORDER BY al.stamp, al.path) as rn
  FROM activity_log al
  WHERE al.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
),
first_pre_event AS (
  SELECT 
    al.session,
    al.search_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.session ORDER BY al.stamp, al.path) as rn
  FROM activity_log al
  INNER JOIN detail_complete_times d ON al.session = d.session
  WHERE al.stamp < d.first_detail_complete
    AND al.search_type <> ''
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) as min_count FROM pre_counts WHERE pre_event_count > 0
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
  SELECT session, first_detail_complete, pre_event_count
  FROM pre_counts
  WHERE pre_event_count = (SELECT min_count FROM min_count)
)
SELECT 
  qs.session,
  fde.path,
  fpe.search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN first_detail_event fde ON fde.session = qs.session AND fde.rn = 1
JOIN first_pre_event fpe ON fpe.session = qs.session AND fpe.rn = 1
ORDER BY qs.session
